Source: npm pack katex@0.18.9; files copied from dist/ (katex.min.js, katex.min.css, contrib/auto-render.min.js, fonts/*.woff2).
Only .woff2 fonts are vendored; the .woff/.ttf fallbacks referenced in katex.min.css are not needed by current browsers.
